claims.text: A machine-learning approach can accurately determine melting temperatures of high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning approach can accurately determine enthalpies of fusion of high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning approach can accurately determine entropies of fusion of high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning approach can accurately determine volume changes at melting for high-entropy alloys.
A machine-learning approach can accurately determine liquid-phase thermodynamic properties of high-entropy alloys.
The machine-learning approach can determine these thermodynamic properties efficiently.
The approach is applicable across the high-entropy-alloy family, including varied compositions and processing techniques.
Alloy composition, processing conditions, and microstructure mediate the predicted thermodynamic properties.
Pattern recognition can identify correlations between alloy composition, processing conditions, and thermodynamic properties.
Pattern recognition can identify correlations between alloy microstructure and thermodynamic properties.
The machine-learning approach will improve predictive accuracy relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The machine-learning approach will improve efficiency relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The quality and quantity of training data may limit the accuracy and efficiency of the approach.
